chapter_info.name: IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) Affinity Group
chapter_info.description: IEEE WIE at GTB4CEC is dedicated to promoting women engineers and inspiring girls around the world to follow their academic interests in a career in engineering and science.
chapter_info.mission: To facilitate the recruitment and retention of women in technical disciplines globally by promoting women engineers and inspiring girls around the world to follow their academic interests in engineering and science.
chapter_info.vision: A vibrant community of women in engineering and technology, supporting each other to reach their full potential.
